title: 按波形为动画配乐
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 从本地 mp3 文件夹中为互动画作《恐龙的最后一天》选择配乐，称其通过查看波形匹配了场景的动感。
summary_en: Author let Opus 5.5 pick music from a folder of mp3s for an interactive dinosaur painting; says it matched the scene's dynamism by looking at waveforms.
author: echohive42

title: 审查 GPT-6 代码的架构问题
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 审查 GPT-6 Sol 写的代码，称其指出代码虽正确但可简化、职责划分不符合既有架构分层，与作者自己的判断一致。
summary_en: Author had Opus 5.5 review GPT-6 Sol's code; it said the code was correct but could be simplified and didn't follow the established architectural layers, which the author says was accurate.
author: miki123211

title: XKCD 漫画解说视频流程
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 配合 ElevenLabs 和 ffmpeg，经风格讨论、脚本、HTML 分镜等分步流程，把一幅 XKCD 漫画做成解说视频，生成约 4500 行 Python 代码。
summary_en: Author turned an XKCD comic into an explainer video with Opus 5.5, ElevenLabs and ffmpeg via a step-by-step process (style, script, HTML storyboard), producing ~4,500 lines of Python.
author: s-macke

title: Clippy's Revenge 视频
summary: Show HN 帖子分享一段标注为由 Opus 5.5 制作的视频《Clippy's Revenge》。
summary_en: Show HN sharing a video, 'Clippy's Revenge', described as made by Opus 5.5.
author: HaxleRose

title: 一次生成产品发布视频
summary: Wasmer 作者称此前手工做发布视频需 6–12 小时，而 Opus 5.5 仅凭博文 Markdown 一个提示就一次生成了视频（HTML+JS 动画再用 ffmpeg 录制），并称该视频走红。
summary_en: Wasmer's author says launch videos previously took 6-12 hours by hand; Opus 5.5 one-shotted one from the blog post markdown (HTML/JS animation recorded with ffmpeg), and he says it went viral.
author: syrusakbary

title: Opus 5.5 擅长解说视频
title_en: Opus 5.5 is good at explainer videos
summary: launchvideo.io 的帖子展示用 Opus 5.5 生成产品解说视频，在 HN 获得 271 分并引发大量讨论。
summary_en: Story linking to launchvideo.io showcasing explainer videos generated with Opus 5.5; 271 points on HN.
author: iacguy

title: 复活 1819 年伊斯坦布尔地图
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 子代理在一个下午做出应用，读取、定位并翻译一幅 1819 年法文博斯普鲁斯地图上的全部 387 个标注，并附写作复盘。
summary_en: Author built an app in an afternoon with Opus 5.5 subagents that reads, maps and translates all 387 labels of an 1819 French Bosphorus map, with a writeup.
author: cahid_arda

title: 含“reasoning”一词即被拒
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 准备代码审查，因提示中含 “reasoning” 一词被分类器拦截整个会话且不说明原因；作者称用 Opus 4.6 分析记录后才定位到该词。
summary_en: Author's Opus 5.5 code-review session was blocked by the classifier with no explanation; per the author, Opus 4.6 later traced it to the word 'reasoning' in the prompt.
author: hungryhobbit

title: 拒答基础分子生物学问题
summary: 博文记录 Opus 5.5 拒绝回答基础分子生物学问题的情况，并讨论开源模型作为替代。
summary_en: Blog post documenting Opus 5.5 refusing basic molecular biology questions and discussing open models as an alternative.
author: bede

title: 2.5D 视差战斗场景
summary: 作者分享由 Opus 5.5 制作的可交互 2.5D 视差战斗场景网页。
summary_en: An interactive 2.5D parallax battle scene web page made by Opus 5.5.
author: echohive42

title: 旅行商问题画肖像
summary: 作者分享由 Opus 5.5 制作的用旅行商问题路径绘制肖像的网页实验。
summary_en: A web experiment by Opus 5.5 that draws a portrait using a traveling-salesman path.
author: echohive42

title: 智能体 CAD 建模对比
summary: PartForge 在其智能体 CAD 建模框架上对比 Sol 6 与 Opus 5.5，称 Opus 5.5 在空间推理和 CAD 编码上提升明显，但出于速度和成本仍默认用 Gemini Flash 3.8。
summary_en: PartForge compared Sol 6 and Opus 5.5 on its agentic CAD harness; says Opus 5.5 is a big jump in spatial reasoning and CAD coding, though Gemini Flash 3.8 stays default for speed/cost.
author: Mazer23

title: 零件目录评测得分75.6%
summary: 帖子报告 Opus 5.5 在 Part Catalog Bench 评测上得分 75.6%。
summary_en: Reports Opus 5.5 scoring 75.6% on Part Catalog Bench.
author: thomas_ma

title: 体育赛事“今天”定义问题
summary: 作者在体育应用中问 Opus 5.5 能否以后端 API 定义“今天”，称其结合提交历史直接给出结论并指出客户端数据可能过期，比 Opus 5 表达清晰。
summary_en: Author asked Opus 5.5 whether a sports app should use the backend's day instead of browser time; says it answered up front citing commit history and flagged stale client data, far clearer than Opus 5.
author: desmondl

title: 错误纠正 Go 超时写法
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 声称 context.WithTimeout 用法错误、应传整数超时并称其为代码库惯例，最终承认所引文档并无此说法。
summary_en: Author says Opus 5.5 claimed context.WithTimeout usage was wrong and timeouts should be ints per 'codebase convention', then admitted the cited docs said no such thing.
author: nijave

title: 安全加固被分类器拦截
summary: 作者称尝试用 Opus 5.5 加固自己应用的安全性时，安全分类器拦截了所有尝试，只能退回 Opus 4.8。
summary_en: Author says attempts to use Opus 5.5 to harden their own app's security were all killed by the security classifier, forcing a fallback to 4.8.
author: rolandf

title: 鹈鹕 SVG 耗尽输出 token
title_en: Pelican SVG runs out of tokens
summary: 作者称画鹈鹕 SVG 测试中，Opus 5.5 用满 128k 输出（思考）token 仍未完成，而 Fable 5.1 max 用约 6.6 万 token 完成。
summary_en: In a pelican SVG test, Opus 5.5 hit the 128k output (thinking) token limit without finishing, while Fable 5.1 max finished in ~66k tokens.
author: narmiouh

title: 为内核审查写提示词
summary: 作者称其 Xen 代码审查流水线的提示词由 Fable 及现在的 Opus 5.5 根据智能体测试失败情况编写和迭代。
summary_en: Author says the prompts in his Xen patch-review pipeline were written and iterated by Fable and now Opus 5.5, based on how agents failed tests.
author: gwd

title: 国际象棋奥赛对局分析
summary: Show HN 项目用 Opus 5.5 结合 Stockfish 分析国际象棋奥林匹克赛对局。
summary_en: Show HN: analysis of Chess Olympiad games using Opus 5.5 and Stockfish.
author: myle

title: 鹈鹕小游戏
summary: 帖子分享由 Claude Opus 5.5 制作的鹈鹕主题网页小游戏。
summary_en: A pelican-themed browser game made with Claude Opus 5.5.
author: denysvitali

title: 《奥兹曼迪亚斯》电影感动画
summary: 作者分享 Opus 5.5 将诗歌《奥兹曼迪亚斯》制作成电影感浏览器动画。
summary_en: Opus 5.5 turned the poem Ozymandias into a cinematic browser animation.
author: echohive42

title: 沿袭旧代码注释风格
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 在处理含大量 Opus 5 生成注释的代码时会模仿其文风，使旧模型风格在代码库中扩散。
summary_en: Author says when Opus 5.5 works on code full of Opus 5-generated comments it picks up that style, making the old style spread.
author: bobbylarrybobby

title: 中文词语解释流水线
summary: 作者在为中文词语写解释的流水线上对比，称 Opus 5.5 在写作和细节上明显优于 Opus 5，但找错时过于吹毛求疵，结论在多数据集上可复现。
summary_en: On a pipeline writing explanations of Chinese words, author found Opus 5.5 clearly better than Opus 5 at writing and detail, but a nitpicky error-finder; repeatable across datasets.
author: comboy

title: 鹈鹕动画转 3D
summary: 作者在 claude.ai 让 Opus 5.5 把 SVG 鹈鹕动画转成 3D 动画，与 Opus 5 同一测试对比称有显著改进，并附两版链接。
summary_en: Author asked Opus 5.5 on claude.ai to turn an animated SVG pelican into a 3D animation; compared with Opus 5 on the same test, reports significant improvement, with links to both.
author: sdthjbvuiiijbb

title: PR 评论回测
summary: 作者用历史 PR 评论回测，称 Opus 5.5 与 Fable 5.1 表现相当，10 个 PR 花费约 24 美元，Astra 正确率明显更差。
summary_en: Author backtested against past PR comments: Opus 5.5 matched Fable 5.1 at about $24 for 10 PRs; Astra did notably worse on correctness.
author: roflc0ptic

title: 简历 STAR 改写成本
summary: 作者用相同上下文和提示把简历条目改写为 STAR 格式，称 Opus 5.5 平均每条约 2.2 美元，而 Fable 5.1 约 4–5 美元。
summary_en: Author rewrote resume lines into STAR format with identical context and prompts; says Opus 5.5 averaged ~$2.2 per line vs ~$4-5 for Fable 5.1.
author: yipinwong

title: 拒答阿尔茨海默病问题
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5（及 Fable）拒绝回答其大学生孩子关于阿尔茨海默病与免疫反应的问题，而 ChatGPT 6 Pro 正常回答。
summary_en: Author says Opus 5.5 (and Fable) refused a college student's question about Alzheimer's and immune response, which ChatGPT 6 Pro answered.
author: sys32768

title: CodeRabbit 代码审查评测
summary: CodeRabbit 博文评测 Opus 5.5 做代码审查：发现的问题更多，但遗漏的类型不同。
summary_en: CodeRabbit blog evaluating Opus 5.5 for code review: more catches, different misses.
author: Leynos

title: 代码点评文风仍旧
summary: 作者贴一段 Vercel DNS 配置代码让 Opus 5.5 点评，其指出硬编码目标、需在 Vercel 控制台添加域名等，但作者称文风节奏与之前相近。
summary_en: Author asked Opus 5.5 to comment on Vercel DNS config code; it flagged the hard-coded target and the missing dashboard step, but author says the cadence/style is largely unchanged.
author: dgroshev
